**Pipeline used.** `/workspace/solve_final.py` (1) parses `input_0.json` for `reference_epoch_day=0.0` and case order; (2) for each case scans a 5,501-point grid P_B in [5,60] d minimising the joint-fit BIC of `offset + sin(2πt/P_B) + cos(2πt/P_B) + sin(4πt/P_B) + cos(4πt/P_B)` then refines within ±0.05 d at 0.0001 d; (3) fits B-only at refined P_B; (4) on the B-only residual scans a 1,281-point grid P_A in [60,700] d with a 2-column A-LS BIC search then refines within ±2 d at 0.01 d; (5) evaluates the joint 7-parameter fit at the chosen (P_B, P_A); (6) applies the approved triple gate: cond1 amp_A > 3*median(|res_b|), cond2 LS false-alarm probability < 1% (Baluev approximation 1-(1-e^-P)^M_eff, M_eff=1281), cond3 residual_variance_reduction > 25%; (7) when present=1, writes the joint 7-parameter coefficients; when present=0, writes the B-only coefficients with all A columns and the candidate P_A neutralised to 0.0; (8) emits target predictions in `input_2.csv` order using `basis1*sin(2πt/P_A) + basis2*cos(2πt/P_A)` when present, else 0.0.

**Why every case is `component_a_present=0`.** With the joint-BIC P_B selection the raw LS periodogram initially mis-identified P_B=13.05 d for case_001 (a second-harmonic alias, B-only RMS=7.75); the corrected BIC P_B=25.93 d drops B-only RMS to 2.80 and reveals the residual noise has variance comparable to the residual periodogram peak in every case. None of the residual periodogram peaks clears the triple gate simultaneously. cond2 (LS false-alarm probability < 1%) is binding for all four cases (M_eff=1281 with very low per-peak LS power), and cond3 also fails because the maximum residual-variance reduction achievable by adding A is 11.4% (case_000), below the 25% threshold.
